The *Abhijānantasatipañha* ("The Question on Prompting Memory") is a short inquiry in the *Milindapañha*, designated as Mil 3.6.11 [SuttaCentral]. Situated within the later strata of the Pali Tipiṭaka / post-canonical literature, it constitutes one of the interrogative exchanges between the Indo-Greek King Milinda and the Buddhist monk Nāgasena concerning psychological aspects of mindfulness and memory [SuttaCentral].
